data.name: Rehnuma
data.gender_notes: Rehnuma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Rahnuma', meaning 'The one who provides comfort'. This name is associated with love, calmness and comfort, making it an ideal choice for parents looking for a name that evokes a sense of serenity and tranquility. The name Rehnuma carries the meaning “Comfort, Love, Calmness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic, Hindi. Parents who choose Rehnuma usually hope their child will grow to embody comfort, love, calmness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine presence of Allah, providing comfort and solace to the soul.
data.etymology: Rehnuma belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comfort, Love, Calmness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rehnuma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رهنماء
in_arabic.long_meaning: رهنماء هي كلمة عربية تعني المرشد أو الدليل، وتستمد من الجذر رشمنء الذي يعود إلى概念 الهداية والتوجيه في الإسلام، وتُستخدم هذه الكلمة لوصف شخص يُقدم الإرشاد والتوجيه للآخرين، وتحمل أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي كونها ترمز إلى概念 الهداية الإلهية

in_urdu.name: رهنماء
in_urdu.long_meaning: رهنماء ایک عربی لفظ ہے جو رہنما یا ہدایت کرنے والے کو کہتے ہیں، یہ لفظ عربي gốc رشمنء سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا تعلق ہدایت اور رہنمائی کے اسلامی تصور سے ہے، یہ لفظ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں بھی اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ الہی ہدایت کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: रेहनुमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रेहनुमा एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका अर्थ मार्गदर्शक या मार्गदर्शन करने वाला होता है, यह शब्द अरबी मूल रशमन से लिया गया है जो इस्लाम में मार्गदर्शन और दिशा की अवधारणा से जुड़ा हुआ है, यह शब्द भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में भी महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह ईश्वरीय मार्गदर्शन का प्रतीक है

Rehnuma further extends the promise of God's eternal guidance and support to those who carry this name, reminding us of the strong bond between Allah and his creation.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Rehnuma" carries profound spiritual significance, signifying the divine presence and guidance inherent in every individual. It serves as an reminder that Allah is with us in times of comfort and hardship, offering solace and direction whenever we may need it. Ultimately, the name acts as a connection to the divine, encouraging those who bear it to turn to Allah for strength and wisdom in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rehnuma, meaning "Guide" in Arabic, signifies the presence of a benevolent and enlightened leader who illuminates the path to knowledge, truth, and righteousness for their followers. This guide is a source of wisdom and inspiration, leading the way to spiritual growth and a closer connection with Allah.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rehnuma was a title given to a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Rehnuma carried significant weight in that era.
